notes.title: PAKO 4 in progress!
notes.content:
We are excited to bring you the next version and the true evolution of the PAKO series. Pako 4 will be going back to the path that Pako 2 took. More open, more realistic (in our way at least), more structured gameplay, more stuff that we are really excited to show you later on. This time there will be truly a living city feel to a huge map. All you here have been sharing lots of stuff and we would greatly appreciate if you would [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3425320/PAKO_4/] WISHLIST PAKO 4[/url] and join the community there. 
We promise to answer as much as possible to requests, wishes and questions. Of course not all is possible since we are a tiny team but we do listen!

notes.title: More content added
notes.content:
Newest update introduces "Challenges" section with 5 mini levels to compete. Dodge the juggernaut cops, find your way through the maze, fight the tanks and more. There's also new camera angle, new leaderboards and a fast car to unlock.

List of added content:
+ 5 Challenge levels
+ Camera angle
+ Unlockable car
+ Leaderboards and achievements

notes.title: Power-ups, cars and camera angles!
notes.content:
Bunch of new items and ammo added, plus you can now USE the items manually. Make time go slower with a Slow-Mo powerup and destroy everything in front of you with Heavy laser beam! 

Oh, and there's more: alternative camera angles can now be changed during gameplay. And we threw in couple of new cars also, hope you have fun!

List of added content: 
+ 2 camera angles: low angle, top view
+ 2 cars: heavy van, classic oldie

+ 10 items:
* Poison others
* Shrink others
* Juggernaut
* Freezefield
* Spider web
* Laser saber
* Mortar
* Airstrike
* Slow-Mo
* Vortex

+4 bullets / ammo types:
* Heavy laser
* Back off
* Poison
* Amok

notes.title: Update in progress (video included)
notes.content:
Down here at the TMG main offices we are preparing new power-ups as an update! just tiny glimpse here in this video, but we have lots of cool new things coming up. Weapons like plasma guns with slow and deadly bullets, super lasers, machine guns, mine-like boxes that fool your enemies and much more. On other bonuses how about dropping some hot lava to ground? Or unleashing a tornado to really eff up everything on its way? Or distracting clones? Or...

You got to stay tuned! We are finalizing sound and graphical effects to these and still fine tuning them but update is almost around the corner.

https://youtu.be/if0SZoV9j5I

Peace,
TMG

notes.title: PAKO Soundtrack Vol. 1 And updates on updates
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26949671/0be51902cfe68247028f15df1fc64c9f7eff0393.jpg[/img]

Anyone liking the music on Pako can check the vol. 1 of the soundtrack! Vol. 2 coming in the next weeks! As Arcade Sushi described:

"The audio work, which is blessed with addictive, electronic music from Finnish producer DKSTR as well as realistic sound effects, is absolutely sublime. Headphones are highly recommended while playing the game, as Pako brings a hypnotic auditory element to the proceedings."

Download the soundtrack here for pay what you want-price (If you dont have the moolah right now,thats cool, just fill in 0$)

https://dkstr.bandcamp.com/album/pako-ost-vol-1

Also, we are working on an update to bring more powerups to the game, we have some pretty pretty cool things cooking here! More news when we know for sure when update goes live!

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Added option to customize the selection of powerups in Practice mode and Multiplayer. For example, you can now enable only drones and ice bullets, or simply deactivate just the negative powerups.

Customize menu is set under Practice/Multiplayer match settings.
